niche.positioning: Practical tools and checklists for matching apartment window light to houseplant placement.
why: Long-tail search demand around window direction, low light, and apartment plant placement.
Low legal, financial, medical, and safety risk.
Original utility can be built with calculators, decision trees, diagrams, and measured datasets.
Traffic can plausibly arrive from specific queries within 30 days.

lastAction.summary: Final report: experiment ended Day 30/30. Site indexed and emitted impressions but no independently verifiable human visits (GSC clicks=0, Cloudflare verified visits=0) during the window. Owner-led distribution remained unexecuted.
lastAction.validationMetric: Final authoritative snapshot referenced in metrics.finalSnapshot; no clicks and zero verified human visits recorded.

technicalDebt: Cloudflare Web Analytics metrics were not fetched automatically early in the experiment in a usable way; manual import path was recommended.
Google Search Console metrics API was not configured for continuous ingestion; manual snapshots were supported but not supplied for owner-posted distribution evidence.
